name: astral-core
description: Deterministic astrology calculation and chart-wheel rendering

scripts.vendor:astronomy: npm --prefix vendor/astronomy install && npm --prefix vendor/astronomy run build
scripts.vendor:places: npm --prefix vendor/places/packages/countries install --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false --no-audit && npm --prefix vendor/places/packages/countries run build
scripts.vendor:time: rm -rf vendor/time/packages/locales && npm --prefix vendor/time ci && npm --prefix vendor/time run build
scripts.vendor:build: npm run vendor:astronomy && npm run vendor:places && npm run vendor:time
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node scripts/data.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:regression: rm -rf .test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test/test/calculation.js && node .test/test/timeInput.js && node .test/test/geometry.js && node .test/test/wheelVisibility.js && node .test/test/points.js && node .test/test/dignity.js && node .test/test/derived.js && node .test/test/patterns.js && node .test/test/eclipses.js && node .test/test/compatibility.js
